_comment: Sample listings for semantic search. summary is the description. Ids are stable so the seed can upsert. property_type must be one of the listing checks.

properties.title: Still Shore Cottage
properties.summary: A small cottage sits on a still shore with a private path down to the water. Guests book short stays through the summer, and the path stays empty after dusk.

properties.title: Lincoln Cul-de-sac House
properties.summary: Four bedrooms open onto a fenced yard on a cul-de-sac two blocks from Lincoln Elementary. Parents walk children to class, and the street has little traffic after the bell.

properties.title: Cafe Street Flat
properties.summary: A second-floor flat sits above a cafe street in the city center. Dinner spots and small offices are a short walk from the front door.

properties.title: Irrigated Crop Parcel
properties.summary: This parcel is large irrigated cropland with long crop rows, a pump shed, and no house. The ground is for production, not for guests or a residence.

properties.title: Midnight Venue Loft
properties.summary: An open loft looks over late-night venues and a busy restaurant row. The train and weekday offices are nearby, and the street stays loud past midnight.

properties.title: Dock House with Guest Bookings
properties.summary: Summer bookings already cover most weekends at this lakeside house. The dock is included with each stay, and last season's guest income was steady.

properties.title: Weekday Office Floor
properties.summary: A downtown office floor has a lobby, elevator banks, and tenants who keep weekday hours. There is no kitchen, no yard, and no place to sleep.

properties.title: Loading Dock Warehouse
properties.summary: A last-mile warehouse has high doors, a loading dock, and room for trucks to turn. It is an industrial building, not a home.
